2556-5744-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
2556-5744-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Roshan, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Mnemonic Wall token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

851-7282-8160.easyPrerequisites:
Kwia's ability hasn't triggered this turn.
You have a way to gain life.
851-7282-8160.description:
Gain life.
Kwia triggers, creating two Lotus tokens due to Adrix and Nev.
Activate a Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {3}.
Activate Chrome Dome by paying {5}, creating two token copies of the Lotus token.
Activate two Loti by tapping and sacrificing them, adding six mana of any color.
Repeat from step 4.
851-7282-8160.notes: Once you have infinite mana, Chrome Dome can target other artifacts as desired.

643-2638-3510-6291.easyPrerequisites: You can cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
643-2638-3510-6291.description:
Cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
Each creature or land that entered is a Saproling through Maskwood Nexus and a Forest in addition to its other types due to and Life and Limb, causing Tireless Tracker to trigger that many times.
Resolve a Tireless Tracker trigger, creating the stated artifact tokens plus at least one creature token through Stridehangar Automaton.
Repeat steps 2-3. Unless you have a way to remove one of the pieces, this will cause an infinite mandatory loop and draw the game.

1981-2415-6794-8249.description:
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Susurian Voidborn and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Susurian Voidborn trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability.
Repeat.

2558-5687-5689-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Skittering Precursor triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield as a 1/1 due to Raiders' Spoils, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Eldrazi Spawn.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability
Repeat.

1308-3129-6753-6763-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Horizon Explorer.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

1887-2021-2060-3062.description:
Activate Simic Ascendancy by paying {1}{G}{U}, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Simic Ascendancy triggers, putting growth counters on it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's second ability by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{G}{U}.
Repeat.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Simic Ascendancy triggers, causing you to win the game.

1978-7290-7826.easyPrerequisites: You control at least three Foods.
1978-7290-7826.description:
Animate Bag End Banquet using Does Machines.
Activate Bag End Banquet by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Bag End Banquet.
Repeat from step 2.

requires.n: Land that adds at least two mana

2597-4019-4221--85--172.description:
Play the land that taps for multiple mana.
That land enters as a creature due to Living Plane, triggering Vigean Graftmage's Graft ability, allowing you to move a +1/+1 counter from Vigean Graftmage to that land.
Cast Wild Growth by paying {G}, attaching it to that land.
Activate that land by tapping it, adding at least two mana.
Wild Growth triggers, adding at least one additional mana.
Activate Vigean Graftmage by paying {1}{U}, untapping the land creature.
Repeat.
2597-4019-4221--85--172.notes:
Note that either the land or the additional mana source must add blue mana.

If the land adds at least {2}{U}, the additional mana source is not necessary.

You may wait a turn after playing the land instead of using the haste enabler.

1090-2350-6867-7056.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Restoration Angel with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Restoration Angel from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Restoration Angel enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and without a -1/-1 counter on it

3099-4565-4762-6627.description:
Activate Leyline of Abundance by paying {6}{G}{G}, putting four +1/+1 counters on each creature you control due to The Earth Crystal and Ozolith, the Shattered Spire.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping Devoted Druid.
Repeat from step 2 three additional times.
Repeat from step 1.

856-5686-5776-7422.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Garrison Excavator trigger.
Resolve the Garrison Excavator trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

955-3259-7354.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
955-3259-7354.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Endless Foot Assault as attackers.
Endless Foot Assault triggers, creating at least one creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

864-1312-2034-4871-7296.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Eternal Witness, adding {C}{C}.
When Eternal Witness dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Doomed Necromancer by paying {B}, tapping it and sacrificing it.
When Doomed Necromancer dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Doomed Necromancer ability, returning Eternal Witness from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Doomed Necromancer from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Doomed Necromancer by paying {2}{B}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

2292-4871-5220-6594.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
2292-4871-5220-6594.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

1017-1594-3532-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Wizard Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

141-3495-6797.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
141-3495-6797.description:
Cast Breach the Multiverse by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Breach the Multiverse.
Holding priority, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Breach the Multiverse, with the copy targeting Naru Meha
Resolve the Breach the Multiverse copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
141-3495-6797.notes: Breach the Multiverse can put all creature cards from all graveyards and libraries onto the battlefield under your control infinitely. It will also infinitely mill all players.

413-3284-3490-4871.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing another creature you control
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Korvold's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Holding priority, activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Resolve the Korvold trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and draw a card.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

1640-4083-5488.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to deal damage to Indoraptor.
Indoraptor is indestructible.
1640-4083-5488.description:
Deal damage to Indoraptor.
Indoraptor and Repercussion trigger.
Resolve the Indoraptor trigger, dealing damage to an applicable target.
Resolve the Repercussion trigger, dealing damage to Indoraptor instead of you due to Pariah's Shield.
Repeat from step 2.

328-2173-2511-5220.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 6 if Gray Merchant is on the top of your library, or you have {3}{B}{B} available otherwise.
328-2173-2511-5220.description:
Cast Gray Merchant either from your hand by paying {3}{B}{B} or from the top of your library by paying 5 life.
When Gray Merchant enters, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose life equal to your devotion to black and causing you to gain life equal to the life lost this way.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Gray Merchant.
When Gray Merchant dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Gray Merchant from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

1309-1462-6801.easyPrerequisites:
You have seven or more cards in your graveyard.
Permanents you control that enter the battlefield untapped can tap to produce at least {1}{W}{W}.
1309-1462-6801.description:
Activate any number of permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least {1}{W}{W}.
Cast Cleansing Meditation by paying {1}{W}{W}, destroying all permanents as they are all enchantments due to Enchanted Evening, and then returning all cards in your graveyard destroyed this way to the battlefield.
When Salvager of Secrets enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Cleansing Meditation from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1309-1462-6801.notes: You can repeat this combo as desired during your turns to continually wipe out opponents' permanents.

2558-4779-6351--109.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a 2/2 creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
2558-4779-6351--109.description:
Cause a 2/2 creature to enter the battlefield under your control, which enters as a 1/1.
Sword of the Meek triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the 1/1 creature.
Teval triggers. Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Resolve the Teval trigger, creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
Repeat from step 2.

3126-4275.description:
Activate Marrow-Gnawer by tapping it and sacrificing another Rat.
When the Rat dies, Faces of the Past triggers, untapping all Rats.
Resolve the Marrow-Gnawer ability, creating a 1/1 Rat creature token for each Rat you control.
Repeat.

406-1339-6235.easyPrerequisites: Tandem Lookout paired with Agate Instigator.
406-1339-6235.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
406-1339-6235.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
The Insect enters the battlefield, triggering Agate Instigator, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Agate Instigator triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

1418-4636-5391.description:
Activate Automated Assembly Line by paying {E}{E}{E}, creating a 3/3 Robot artifact creature token.
When the Robot enters the battlefield, Gonti's Aether Heart triggers twice, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

154-1331-4772-5157.notablePrerequisites:
Scythe of the Wretched attached to Fierce Witchstalker.
You control at least two Foods.
154-1331-4772-5157.description:
Activate Asmoranomardicadaistinaculdacar by sacrificing two Foods, causing Fierce Witchstalker to deal six damage to itself.
Fierce Witchstalker dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Scythe of the Wretched triggers, returning Fierce Witchstalker from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Scythe of the Wretched to it.
When Fierce Witchstalker enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating two Food tokens.
Repeat.

3752-3792.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to kill Phage.
3752-3792.description:
Kill Phage, triggering its ability, causing target opponent to return Phage to the battlefield under their control from your graveyard at the beginning of the next end step.
At the beginning of your end step, Phage triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield under the opponent's control.
When Phage enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, causing its controller to lose the game.

876-2581-2882.notablePrerequisites:
Infinite Reflection attached to Dauthi Voidwalker.
You control at least one additional nontoken creature.
An opponent has a creature card in exile with a void counter on it.
876-2581-2882.description:
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to any Dauthi Voidwalker you control except the one with Infinite Reflection attached.
Activate the Dauthi Voidwalker with Lightning Greaves attached by tapping and sacrificing it.
If the creature was owned by an opponent, it is exiled with a void counter instead of being put into its owner's graveyard.
Resolve the Dauthi Voidwalker ability, causing you to cast a creature card from an opponent's exile without paying its mana cost.
The creature enters the battlefield as a copy of Dauthi Voidwalker due to Infinite Reflection.
Repeat.

914-3249-4050.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least three artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-3249-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Dockside Extortionist, adding {R}.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast Dockside Extortionist from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Dockside Extortionist by paying {1}{R}.
Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, creating at least three Treasure tokens.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}.
Repeat.
